name: TerraFleet Autonomous Garden Robotics
tag: Plans and coordinates garden robots that water, weed and scout your beds.

scenarios.title: Tend beds before rain
scenarios.ask: Tend beds 1 to {beds} today with {robots} robot(s). Chance of rain tomorrow is {rain}.
steps: Sensors
Soil moisture is low in {=ceil(beds / 3)} bed(s). The rest are fine.
Planner
Cut the watering plan by {=round(rain * 0.75)}% because of the forecast. Light top-up for dry beds only.
Weeder bot
Cleared weeds in {=ceil(beds / 3)} bed(s). {=ceil(beds / 3) * 106} weeds removed.
Scout bot
Aphids spotted on one kale bed. Photo sent for review.
followups: What if the rain doesn't come?
The planner checks soil moisture the next morning and waters any bed below its target.
Do the robots spray anything for the aphids?
No. The scout sends a photo and suggestions. You decide on treatment.

scenarios.title: Plan a planting season
scenarios.ask: Plan a season of {crop} across {beds} beds with {robots} robots.
steps: Planner
Built a sowing calendar with {crop} rotated across {beds} beds.
Succession
Planned {=crop} sowing round(s) so harvests are spread out.
Fleet
Gave each robot about {=round(beds / robots, 1)} beds to tend.
Calendar
Scheduled weekly weeding and daily moisture checks.
followups: Yes. Move any sowing date and the robots' schedules update.
This plan covers watering, weeding and scouting. Harvesting stays with people.

scenarios.title: Size a robot fleet
scenarios.ask: How many robots do we need for {area} of beds, with {hours} of robot work a day?
steps: Survey
Mapped {area} of beds and the paths between them.
Workload
Estimated {=round(area * 0.025, 1)} robot hours a day for watering, weeding and scouting.
Fleet
Recommended {=max(1, ceil(area * 0.025 / hours))} robot(s) working {hours} a day.
Charging
Placed {=max(1, ceil(max(1, ceil(area * 0.025 / hours)) / 2))} charging dock(s) at bed ends.

result.title: Fleet size
rows: {=round(max(1, ceil(area * 0.025 / hours)) * hours - area * 0.025, 1)} hours a day

followups: What if we add more beds?
The sizer re-runs and shows when one more robot is needed.
Yes. The planner staggers charging so two robots share one dock.
